@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+create table public.journal_entries (
+  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
+  plant_id uuid not null references public.plants (id) on delete cascade,
+  note text not null,
+  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
+);
+
+create index journal_entries_user_id_idx on public.journal_entries (user_id);
+
+grant select, insert, update, delete on public.journal_entries to authenticated;

expectedFindings.label: table in the exposed public schema without row level security: every user can read and edit everyone's entries
